expected_level_description: You can: - run the legal team's administration and improve its processes - report on workload, spending on external lawyers, and turnaround times - administer legal technology, such as matter management and e-signature tools
You can: - research a defined legal question and summarise the sources clearly - check that sources are current and authoritative - keep precedent and know-how libraries up to date

You can: - review routine agreements, such as non-disclosure and simple services agreements, against the organisation's standards - mark up contracts and explain the changes - spot clauses that need a lawyer's review, such as unlimited liability or automatic renewal
You can: - explain the main stages of a claim or dispute - log claims and track deadlines accurately
You can: - explain the basic principles of data protection and confidentiality - recognise information requests and data breaches and route them correctly

You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team - be an advocate for the team externally, and can manage differing perspectives - shape and share communications relevant to the audience
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
